system.description: When speaking with an intelligent creature who can understand you and isn't hostile, you convince them to take one reasonable action in the next round. A reasonable action must be agreed upon by your GM; it should not put the creature or its allies in obvious danger or be wildly out of character. Action. Hand to Eye (2 Speed or Intellect): When you roll to accomplish a task involving manual dexterity or mental agility—pickpocketing, lockpicking, games involving agility, and so on—and your roll is less than a 9, treat the roll as a 9. (This means you don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1.) Effort: Increase the minimum number rolled for this ability by 3. Enabler. At tier 3: The minimum number rolled for this ability increases to 12.
